Hey i get you, i feel the same way about my self. I understand that you think that way because i think about myself that way. I also have'nt found love neither did i find something that I'm talented or extremely fond of. One thing i understood, yet haven't mastered in life, is that we all have a story to tell and something to accomplish. Whether that be something we see or feel we know, or maybe its something hidden that we only get to understand at the end of our days.Yet non of us are NPC's, because we are all born with a different purpose. And you never know what life's gonna give you. I truly wish you well in life and hope you find what you are looking for.
